launch_topology.future_readiness: schema, policy, audit, and denial rails may support additional owner-approved tenants or seats later; launch behavior remains single-tenant and two-person
explicit_exclusions: customer ownership transfer of platform or intellectual property
customer control of source, infrastructure, security policy, or roadmap
billing or metering as a launch product feature

tenant_context_contract.authoritative_source: server derives tenant context from the verified session, actor assignment, and server-owned resource mapping
tenant_context_contract.client_input_policy: tenant identifiers, tenant headers, query parameters, route fields, model output, local cache values, or attachment metadata supplied by a client are never authoritative and are refused when they conflict
tenant_context_contract.resource_rule: every canonical record, projection, event, job, attachment, search result, export row, Doc context link, AI request, and local-sync receipt is bound to exactly one tenant_id
tenant_context_contract.authorization_rule: authorize both actor and exact resource against the same server-derived tenant before existence, metadata, content, search match, attachment, export, or model context is disclosed
tenant_context_contract.privacy_rule: cross-tenant and nonexistent targets use the same privacy-safe outward response and do not disclose existence

server_owned_allow_list: retention choices within the owner policy floor and ceiling
seat-safe display identity and notification preferences
tenant_configuration_contract.validation_rule: configuration is strict-schema, versioned, tenant-bound, owner-approved where consequential, audited, and read back after change
forbidden_configuration: retention below the owner policy floor

required_assertions: conflicting untrusted tenant hint is ignored for authority and refused
no object existence, metadata, search hit, export row, attachment, Doc context, or AI context is returned
privacy-safe response matches the nonexistent-target response
attributed denial evidence contains no business payload

workflow_definition_contract.immutable_version_rule: each executable workflow version is immutable and tenant-bound; revision creates a new version
workflow_definition_contract.running_work_rule: running or queued work remains pinned to the exact workflow version unless an owner-approved, rehearsed migration explicitly replaces it

stage_rules.experimental: synthetic or isolated exploration only; no routine production reliance
stage_rules.pilot: explicitly bounded tenant, people, records, time, and rollback; visible as pilot
stage_rules.approved: owner-approved for the named bounded workflow but not yet the default
stage_rules.standard: owner-approved default after cutover, rollback, and observation evidence
stage_rules.retired: new starts refused; history and pinned evidence remain readable

workflow_definition_contract.rollback_rule: rollback selects a previously evidenced immutable version, records the reason and affected work, rehearses recovery, preserves audit history, and requires fresh read-back
workflow_definition_contract.cutover_rule: old workflow behavior is not retired until parity, routine displacement, owner approval, migration disposition, rollback, and observation gates pass

locked: data classification and retention policy bounds
release, rollback, backup, restore, and live verification gates
flexible_within_schema: Doc prompt presentation without authority expansion
workflow steps whose risk, tenant, approval, audit, retention, and rollback rails remain unchanged
mature_rail_boundary.rule: a flexible change that touches a locked rail becomes a material revision and must not reuse prior approval

bounded_workflow_trial_acceptance.duration: at most five business days; shorter trials are allowed
bounded_workflow_trial_acceptance.scope: one named tenant, workflow, version, partner cohort, record allow-list, and rollback owner
entry_evidence: baseline for the routine being tested
pass: all consequential effects match exact approval and fresh read-back
Joe and Dell can complete and understand the routine without a heavy AI session
observed toil and exceptions are attributed
owner approves promotion from the collected evidence
safety_clause: trial creates no new source of truth
trial does not introduce or depend on a generic workflow engine
bounded_workflow_trial_acceptance.failure: hold or roll back the pilot, preserve evidence, and revise into a new immutable workflow version; never promote by calendar passage

normal_internal_target_human_hours_per_m.interpretation: operating target, not an invented baseline or guaranteed cap

maintenance_accounting_contract.baseline_status: Unknown until time diary, work-request classification, and interview evidence exist
maintenance_accounting_contract.reporting_rule: report normal internal hours separately from every attributed exception; never average an exception into the target silently
maintenance_accounting_contract.escalation_gate: more than five normal internal maintenance hours in each of two consecutive months creates prioritized toil-reduction work
maintenance_accounting_contract.escalation_output: one prioritized, tenant-bound work request names the repeated toil, accountable owner, evidence, acceptance, risk, and proposed governed product, automation, runbook, or workflow simplification
maintenance_accounting_contract.low_toil_mature_claim_gate: a low-toil or mature claim requires three complete consecutive normal months at three to five human hours, with required control evidence intact and exceptions reported separately
maintenance_accounting_contract.bound_product_action: when the two-consecutive-month escalation gate fires, create prioritized toil-reduction work for the repeated toil
maintenance_accounting_contract.post_launch_comparison: compare like-for-like rolling monthly normal internal hours and separately reported exceptions at 30, 60, and 90 days; do not make a low-toil or mature claim before the three-complete-consecutive-month gate passes

phase_boundary.construction_gate: Production construction remains closed until Joe approves the frontier-model council output from the latest qualified Claude, Codex, and Grok models run at exactly high effort, and Phase 0 exit evidence passes.
